semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Teesing Taiwan LTD. supplies components and systems that are relevant to the semiconductor industry, particularly in the area of gas and liquid transport for critical processes.
summary: Teesing Taiwan LTD. is an international supplier of ultra-high purity (UHP) and high purity (HP) parts for semiconductor technology, providing fittings, valves, tubing, and assemblies. The company focuses on delivering high-quality connectivity solutions and customized products to meet the specific demands of critical semiconductor processes.
capabilities: Custom assemblies for gas and liquid transport

regional_presence.Taiwan: Teesing has a presence in Taiwan, supporting the semiconductor industry with local sales and services.
regional_presence.United States: The company operates a sales office in New Jersey to cater to North American markets.
regional_presence.China: Teesing has a sales office in Beijing to serve the growing semiconductor market in China.
regional_presence.Europe: The headquarters in the Netherlands supports operations across Europe, focusing on high niche markets.
